properties.name: gauntlet.application.id
properties.description: Canonical Adapter v1 application ID. Required when the adapter is enabled.

properties.name: gauntlet.application.label
properties.description: Human-readable application label. Required when the adapter is enabled.

properties.name: gauntlet.application.environment.name
properties.description: Explicit non-production environment name. Required when the adapter is enabled.

properties.name: gauntlet.application.environment.kind
properties.description: Exact environment kind: development, test, qa, staging, uat, preview, or sandbox. Required when the adapter is enabled.

properties.name: gauntlet.idempotency-secret
properties.description: Stable application secret used only for HMAC idempotency fingerprints. An enabled adapter requires at least 32 UTF-8 bytes; every replica sharing a RunStore must use the same value.
